summary: Completed testing of two new features: (1) Admin image upload to /api/admin/upload with file serving via /api/uploads/<filename>, and (2) Launch notification signups via /api/collections/<slug>/notify with admin dashboard at /admin/notifications. Backend tests: 32/33 passed (97%). Frontend tests: All major flows working correctly.

minor_bugs.issue: Path traversal test returns 404 instead of expected 400
minor_bugs.impact: Very low - path traversal is still blocked, just with different status code

ui_bugs.issue: On collections list page, after submitting notify form on coming-soon cards, the confirmation message 'We'll write when [Collection] launches' does not appear to replace the form. The API call succeeds (verified in backend tests and admin dashboard), but the UI state doesn't update to show the confirmation.
ui_bugs.workaround: The notification is successfully saved in the backend. The hero variant on collection detail pages (/collections/bamboo) works correctly and shows the confirmation message.

Backend: POST /api/admin/upload with valid image returns {url, filename, size}
Backend: GET /api/uploads/<filename> serves uploaded file with correct content-type
Backend: POST /api/admin/upload rejects non-image files with 400
Backend: POST /api/admin/upload rejects invalid image data with 400
Backend: GET /api/uploads/nonexistent returns 404
Backend: POST /api/collections/<slug>/notify creates notification successfully
Backend: POST /api/collections/<slug>/notify handles duplicate emails correctly (returns already:true)
Backend: POST /api/collections/unknown-slug/notify returns 404
Backend: POST /api/collections/<slug>/notify with invalid email returns 400
Backend: GET /api/admin/notifications requires admin auth (401 without token)
Backend: GET /api/admin/notifications returns list of signups sorted by created_at desc
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/notifications/{nid} deletes notification successfully
Backend regression: All previously-passing endpoints still work (home, collections, products, journal, artisans, admin CRUD)
Frontend: Guest user can submit email on coming-soon collection detail page (Bamboo) - toast and confirmation message appear correctly
Frontend: Collections list page shows notify forms only on coming-soon collections (4 forms for Wood, Bamboo, Fabric, Wool)
Frontend: Terracotta (Available) collection does NOT show notify form
Frontend: Admin dashboard shows 'Notify-me' count card with correct number
Frontend: Admin sidebar includes 'Notify-me' menu item
Frontend: Admin products page has ImageUploader component with 'Upload images' button
Frontend: Admin notifications page shows correct title, filter dropdown, and Export CSV button
Frontend: Admin notifications page displays email entries grouped by collection with delete buttons
Frontend: Filter dropdown includes 'All collections' and individual collection options with counts

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (1 minor UI state issue on collections list cards)

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix NotifyMeForm confirmation message display on collections list page cards. The form submission works correctly (API call succeeds), but the React state doesn't update to show the confirmation message. The hero variant on collection detail pages works correctly. Investigate why the card variant's 'done' state isn't persisting or rendering the confirmation message.
